query: INSERT INTO embedding_jobs(tenant,kind,object_id) SELECT tenant,'document',document_id||':'||position FROM knowledge_chunks WHERE tenant=$1 AND document_id=$2 AND (embedding IS NULL OR embedding_model<>$3 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM embedding_jobs j WHERE j.tenant=knowledge_chunks.tenant AND j.kind='document' AND j.object_id=knowledge_chunks.document_id||':'||knowledge_chunks.position)) ON CONFLICT(tenant,kind,object_id) DO UPDATE SET available_at=now(),attempts=0,error_code=NULL
